parole.testo: Internationalism, ultimately based on Kongo Kongo (“Kongo people”). Compare Kongo Kikongo (“Kongo language”), formed from ki- (“class 7 prefix used to form language names”) and Kongo (“Kongo people”). The exact immediate route into Norwegian is uncertain.
